name: Cloudflare IP
description: Automatically syncs Cloudflare IP ranges into Nginx UI Access Lists with independent toggles for IPv4 and IPv6.
author: PeterGamez

permission_reasons.kv: Stores sync status, configuration, and cached Cloudflare IP ranges in plugin KV store.
permission_reasons.network: Fetches the latest official IP ranges directly from cloudflare.com.
permission_reasons.notify: Sends notifications when IP synchronization succeeds or encounters issues.
permission_reasons.core_api: Accesses Nginx UI Access Lists REST API to create and synchronize Cloudflare IP lists.
